Every intrinsic multiplicity is identified with every actual presentation fibre. The presentation-free maximum over all monic irreducibles is proved bounded and attained, and equals both natural-valued and cardinal-valued seed rank. No caller-supplied decomposition or seed-count conclusion is needed by the public maximum theorem. These are noncomputable mathematical constructions. The printed proof uses a different route through local-module/Nakayama machinery; that separately listed machinery is not thereby marked complete.

The arbitrary-field cyclic/minpoly bridge, primary label injectivity criterion, and conditional invariant-factor count remain proved.
